name: Pact Boon

options.name: Pact of the Blade
options.summary: You can use your action to create a magical pact weapon in your empty hand. You choose the melee weapon's form each time you create it, and you are proficient with it while you wield it.
options.shortLabel: Create or bind a magical pact weapon.
keyFacts: The weapon counts as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
The weapon disappears if it is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute, if you use this feature again, if you dismiss it, or if you die.
You can transform one magic weapon into your pact weapon with a 1-hour ritual, and it appears whenever you create your pact weapon.

options.name: Pact of the Chain
options.summary: You learn the find familiar spell and can cast it as a ritual. It does not count against your number of spells known.
options.shortLabel: Gain an empowered familiar through find familiar.
keyFacts: When you cast find familiar, you can choose an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite as a special form.
When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to let your familiar make one attack with its reaction.

options.name: Pact of the Tome
options.summary: Your patron gives you a Book of Shadows. Choose three cantrips from any class's spell list; while the book is on your person, you can cast those cantrips at will.
options.shortLabel: Gain a Book of Shadows and three cantrips.
keyFacts: The cantrips do not count against your number of cantrips known.
If a chosen cantrip is not on the warlock spell list, it is still a warlock spell for you.
If you lose the book, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony during a short or long rest to receive a replacement.

options.name: Pact of the Talisman
options.summary: Your patron gives you a talisman that can aid the wearer when the need is great. When the wearer fails an ability check, they can add a d4 to the roll.
options.shortLabel: Gain a talisman that improves failed ability checks.
keyFacts: The d4 can turn the failed ability check into a success.
The talisman can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and all expended uses return when you finish a long rest.
If you lose the talisman, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony during a short or long rest to receive a replacement.

summary: At 3rd level, your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. Choose one Pact Boon option.
